_note: GraphQL operations exactly as RUCKUS One's own web UI sends them to the analytics service (undocumented; experimental).

queries.TopTraffic: query($start:DateTime,$end:DateTime,$path:[HierarchyNodeInput]){ network(start:$start,end:$end){ hierarchyNode(path:$path){ apps: topNApplicationByTraffic(n:10){ name applicationTraffic } appClients: topNApplicationByClient(n:10){ name clientCount } categories: topNApplicationCategories(n:10){ dataUsage{ name value } clientCount{ name value } } ssids: topNSSIDByTraffic(n:10){ name userTraffic clientCount } aps: topNApsByTraffic(n:10){ apName apMac traffic } clients: topNClientsByTraffic(n:10){ hostname clientMac traffic } } } }
queries.FailuresByStage: query($start:DateTime,$end:DateTime,$path:[HierarchyNodeInput],$stage:String){ network(start:$start,end:$end){ hierarchyNode(path:$path){ ssid: topNSSIDbyConnFailure(n:10,stage:$stage){ key name value } ap: topNNodebyConnFailure(n:10,stage:$stage){ key name value } maker: topNManufacturersByConnFailure(n:10,stage:$stage){ key name value } } } }
